rv.q: Sulfur Bottom may stumble, but with a poignant message and a portrayal of a particular kind of modern despair, it is nonetheless moving.
Varma's complicated storytelling doesn't serve the play's mission to call attention to environmental injustice.
However, in this form, the play is neither coherent nor convincing as an ecological polemic.
Rather than pulled by our ears to hard conclusions, the audience is gently held in revelatory visions.
Making his Off-Broadway debut with Sulfur Bottom, the playwright—a 2022 college grad—may not yet have the skill set for a compelling environment-themed allegory.
